integrity: An analytic proof supports the universal statements. An executable independently recalculates diagnostic identities and high-precision test cases; finite tests do not establish infinite assertions. Publication priority remains relative to inspected primary sources; no independent scientific audit was performed.
limitations: Restricted to gain greater than the unique cubic one-step expansion threshold and to survival within [0,1]; no classification at lower overcritical gain, no fixed-gain closed-form Hausdorff dimension or escape rate, no claim about excursions outside the observation interval.
title: A postcritical Cantor repeller with explicit escape and fractal asymptotics in a rational logistic map
